service.name: Solo guitarist
service.serviceType: Solo guitarist for cocktail hours, client dinners and private dinners
service.description: One voice and a guitar, or instrumental guitar, playing blues, roots, jazz and Spanish-tinged sets for cocktail hours, client dinners and private dinners across Denver and the Colorado mountain corridor.

faqs.q: What does the solo guitarist play?
faqs.a: Blues, roots, jazz standards and Spanish-tinged sets, sung or purely instrumental. The choice follows the occasion: instrumental guitar sits easiest under dinner conversation, and a voice carries a cocktail hour or a patio. Send a do-not-play list or build the set with us, and the first learned song is included in every booking.

faqs.q: How much space and power does a solo guitarist need?
faqs.a: A 6 by 4 ft corner, one dedicated 20-amp circuit, and 45 minutes for load-in, with strike in 30. The circuit needs to be dedicated rather than shared with catering equipment, which is the detail most often missed. Full footprints for every size are on the technical page.

faqs.q: Is one guitarist enough for a cocktail hour?
faqs.a: For a shorter guest list, yes. A solo holds a cocktail hour or a dinner at conversation volume, 65 to 72 dBA at the nearest table. When the crowd is large enough that one instrument disappears into it, the duo is the answer, and both figures sit on the published rate card.

A working guitarist from the roster. The booking is sold by its spec: the instrumentation, the repertoire and the volume above, at a published price. That is the promise we can keep on every date the format is available, and it is the same rule every spec'd format on the roster follows.

faqs.q: Can the solo guitarist play outdoors?
faqs.a: Yes, on a covered, level and dry performance area with power run to it. Colorado evenings drop fast, and instruments and electronics both stop behaving in the cold and the wet, so cover is required and a move-indoors call time goes in the plan. Patios and courtyards are this format's regular work.
